description: A contemporary retelling where Halvor’s listless life in a small edge-of-town home breaks open through a container ship voyage, deserted glass-and-steel “castles” that feel like luxury compounds, and a warm smart-ring whose wish-magic collides with modern pride, gossip, and a wedding turned public reckoning—while trolls remain brutally real.
tone: Contemporary folktale adventure with romance, wonder, and sharp consequences
summary: A drifting young man rescues three heiresses from monstrous trolls, loses them through a careless boast, and races back to reclaim the love he earned.
